main_text.head: IRENICI
LIBER PRIMUS,
Exhibens pacificam responsionem ad memoratas Aporias: Interspersis etiam aliis ad rem præsentem pertinentibus.
CAPUT I. De Geniculatione in Sacra Cœna,

p.i: Respondetur ad majorem Propositionem primæ Aporiæ, usque ad §. 9. Respondetur ad ejusdem minorem, §. 9. ad secundam Aporiam respondetur §. 10. ad tertiam, §. 11. ad quartam, §. 12.

main_text.p: Ad primæ Aporiæ propositionem majorem.AD primi Argumenti majorem Propositionem. 1. Supervacua & inutilis est limitatio ista per distinctionem rerum consecratarum à rebus non consecratis, nam ad idololatriam nihil interest, sive creatura consecrata, quæ adoratur, an non consecrata; sive sacram habeat significationem, sive non habeat. Nam honoris soli DEO debiti translatio ad quamcunque rem quæ non est natura DEVS, sive etiam ad quodcunque figmentum; idololat

page.notes: The initial A is a large woodcut letter, read as "A" and joined to "D primi" as "AD primi". The right margin note is set in small type. The last line is cut off at the foot and continues on the next page as "idololatriam". The number "1." before "Supervacua" is treated as a paragraph number within the text.
